result.topic_en: Heavily corrected draft of a referee report on an essay submitted for the mathematical prize question under the motto 'Tanto uberiores sunt notae, quanto magis exprimunt rerum relationes'; it praises the author's diligence and the method of §6 and notes that the investigations of §§14–15 were missed in the later development.
